The '''bioinduction gun''' was designed by [[Hugo Cutter]]. It sent electrical charges to a target's brain to overcome the hypo-reflexive cortex to trigger sleep. It worked on [[Gigoran/Legends|Gigorans]], but did not work on [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]], or [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronians]].
